Sailingstone Capital Partners Raised Its Range Res (RRC) Position; As Autozone (AZO) Stock Value Declined, Shareholder Telemus Capital Has Lowered Stake by $413,091
May 3, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Sailingstone Capital Partners Llc increased its stake in Range Res Corp (RRC) by 7.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sailingstone Capital Partners Llc bought 2.62M shares as the company’s stock declined 13.12% with the market. The institutional investor held 35.83M shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $611.30M, up from 33.21 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sailingstone Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Range Res Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.85% or $0.255 $13.515. About 5.21M shares traded. Range Resources Corporation (NYSE:RRC) has declined 48.60% since May 3, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 60.15% the S&P500.
Telemus Capital Llc decreased its stake in Autozone Inc (AZO) by 8.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Telemus Capital Llc sold 581 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.64% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,230 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.43 million, down from 6,811 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Telemus Capital Llc who had been investing in Autozone Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.11 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.90% or $5.66 $635.84. About 228,605 shares traded. AutoZone, Inc. (NYSE:AZO) has declined 11.15% since May 3, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.70% the S&P500.
